title: Databricks SQL version 2026.45 is now available in Preview
body:
Databricks SQL version 2026.45 is now available in the **Preview** channel. Review the following section to learn about new features.

#### Share views with or without history

`ALTER SHARE ... ADD VIEW` and `ALTER SHARE ... ALTER VIEW` now accept the `WITH HISTORY` and `WITHOUT HISTORY` clauses. Existing history defaults are unchanged.
